conclusion:
ADJUDICATION - U-1 (EST / NQT / YMT / IPT / RVT, and by the same reasoning EMT, R1T, RGT, RLT and the eleven 18-070 sector roots).

RULING: the equity-index BTIC family closes daily at 16:00 ET / 15:00 CT. All five gate roots are keyable on `globex_equity_index_btic`. None stays withheld.

1. THE CONFLICT IS NOT "SPEC vs FEED". IT IS A LOST VENUE LABEL INSIDE THE SPEC CHANNEL.
CME publishes TWO BTIC windows for these products and has done so since the family's launch document: a CME Globex BTIC window of 18:00-16:00 ET, and a CME ClearPort ("CPC") BTIC window of 18:00-17:00 ET. The 2015 New Product Summary prints them on consecutive lines under one "Trading Hours" heading - "Globex: Sunday- Friday 6:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m. New York time/ET (5:00 p.m. - 3:00 p.m. Chicago Time/CT)" against "CPC: Sunday - Friday 6:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m. New York time/ET (5:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m. Chicago Time/CT)".
Every 17:00 ET reading in the disputed cells is that ClearPort window with its label dropped:
 - productId 8027 (IPT) carries ONE row, `"venue":"Default:"`, whose text is byte-identical - after HTML-entity and whitespace normalisation, checked programmatically - to the `"venue":"CME ClearPort:"` row on productId 7969 (NQT), the one equity-BTIC product record that is still venue-split.
 - productId 7968 (EST) likewise carries one `"venue":"Default:"` row, and its text is not BTIC text at all: "Sunday - Friday 5:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m. CT with a 60-minute break each day beginning at 4:00 p.m." is the ES outright/ClearPort envelope in CME's modern phrasing. Its record also links the ES rulebook chapter and the shared ES page URL.
 - 7969 itself, unbroken, prints `"venue":"CME Globex:"` at "Sunday - Friday 6:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m. ET (5:00 p.m. - 3:00 p.m. CT)".
So `docs/schedules/sources.md`'s "product specifications control" for US-CME-GROUP is SATISFIED BY THE SPECIFICATION CHANNEL ITSELF. Read wherever it still labels the venue, it says 16:00 ET: seven venue-labelled live records do (7969 NQT, 133 ES, 166 EMD, 170 RSG, 7945 RS1, 8026 IPO, 8314 RTY), plus the one archived capture of that channel (166, 2021-07-10). The rule does not have to be overridden; the two "Default:" cells are simply not Globex statements.

2. THE 15:00 CT CLOSE IS STATED IN SESSION LANGUAGE IN THREE INDEPENDENT PRIMARY CHANNELS, NOT INFERRED FROM A FEED OR A SETTLEMENT INSTANT.
 (a) CME's own launch New Product Summary, under the heading "Trading Hours": "Globex: Sunday- Friday 6:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m. New York time/ET (5:00 p.m. - 3:00 p.m. Chicago Time/CT); Monday - Thursday 5:00 p.m. - 6:00 p.m. ... daily maintenance period."
 (b) CME's own server-rendered E-mini S&P 500 contract-specification page, captured on the launch Sunday 2015-11-15 and again 2016-02-01, 2018-04-19 and 2019-01-30: "For the BTIC, trading hours will be Sunday - Friday 6:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m. New York time/ET (5:00 p.m. - 3:00 p.m. Chicago Time/CT)", printed adjacent to the outright's 17:00 ET line and ClearPort's 17:00 ET line. From 2018 the same page compresses it to "BTIC: Sunday - Friday 6:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m. ET".
 (c) A CFTC Regulation 40.6(a) self-certification - CME Submission 18-070 (2 of 2), 2018-03-08 - under the explicit heading "Hours of BTIC trading on CME Globex:", reading "Sunday-Friday 5:00 p.m.- 3:00 p.m. Central Time/(CT) (6:00 p.m. - 4:00 p.m. Eastern Time/(ET))", with an unconditional day-level effective date and a table of eleven sector BTIC codes.
The session service (`closed@15:00` for security groups SB, NB, DB, R3, IT, PB, R1, R2, RT, against `closed@16:00` for ES and IX in the same response) is CORROBORATION, not the basis. This clears the handoff's decision rule with three statements to spare, and it clears LAW-SESSION-NOT-EXPIRY: the 2018 page prints "BTIC trading terminates at 4:00 p.m. Eastern Time (ET) on the Thursday before the 3rd Friday of contract month" as a SEPARATE Termination-of-Trading row, and that row is not used.

3. THE RSV OUTLIER NEEDS NO ERROR FINDING.
productId 7948 is the RSV *underlying*, not RVT (RVT is productId 7949, security group R3, and the ContractSpecs service returns "-" for it, as it does for YMT/7970 - so the handoff's "productId 7948 (RSV)" citation for RVT is an underlying-page citation, and its productId is wrong for the BTIC product). 7948's `"venue":"CME Globex:"` row reads "BTIC: Sunday - Friday 6:00p.m. - 5:00 p.m. ET" - the only CME statement anywhere putting an equity BTIC close at 17:00 ET under a Globex label, isolated against its three Russell siblings and the MidCap page at 4:00 p.m., and the only one carrying a hand-typed defect ("6:00p.m."). Under the repo's sourced-intersection convention it does not need to be declared wrong: 16:00 ET and 17:00 ET intersect at a 16:00 ET close, which is the recommended grid. Record the conflict beside the table and serve the intersection.

4. THE FAMILY CLOCK STARTS 2015-11-16, UNCONDITIONALLY.
CME Submission 15-438 and CBOT Submission 15-437 (both 2015-10-28) each state "effective on Sunday, November 15, 2015 for trade date Monday, November 16, 2015" with no condition attached. They state NO hours anywhere - only the 3:45 p.m. BTIC price-determination procedure, which is a pricing rule, not a session boundary - so they supply the day and the spec/NPS supply the grid. The 2015 New Product Summary cannot supply the day on its own: its footer reads "Pending All Relevant CFTC Regulatory Review Periods". Before 2015-11-16 the family did not exist, so the key's pre-launch era is a sourced closure, exactly as for a launch-dated venue - not a carried-back grid.
Under AGENTS.md ("Adding or revising a product-family key", item 2), IPT, RVT, EMT and the eleven 18-070 sector roots joining later are caller catalog data; their own listing filings are not needed to key the family, which is why the unlocated IPT/RVT launch certifications are not a blocker.

5. THE HALT QUESTION (the gate's second half): NO. THERE IS NO 15:15-15:30 CT HALT HISTORY ON THIS KEY, AND NO 2021 REVISION ROW.
 - Structural: the halt ran 15:15-15:30 CT. The BTIC book closed at 15:00 CT from its first day. A halt cannot fall inside a session that has already ended.
 - Documentary, at the launch: the 2015-11-15 capture attaches "with 15-minute trading halt Monday - Friday 4:15 p.m. - 4:30 p.m. New York time/ET (3:15 p.m. - 3:30 p.m. Chicago Time/CT)" to the CME Globex OUTRIGHT line only; the adjacent BTIC sentence carries no halt clause. Same in 2016-02-01, 2018-04-19 and 2019-01-30.
 - Documentary, at the removal: CME Globex Notice 2021-06-21 - "Effective this Sunday, June 27 (trade date Monday, June 28), CME Group will eliminate the 15 minute market pause from 3:15-3:30 ... Please note: S&P 500 futures and options (250 multiplier) as well as all BTIC and TACO products will not be impacted." Its linked affected-product list enumerates tag-1151 security groups (ES, NQ, YM, IX, RV, ME, XB, XR, ...) and contains NO BTIC security group: SB, NB, DB, R3, IT, PB, R1, R2 and RT are all absent from it.
 - SER-8788 section 5 states the change but is CONDITIONAL - its own header reads "(Effective June 28, 2021 - pending CFTC review)" and its body "Subject to regulatory review and effective June 28, 2021" - and it names no product code, so it neither includes nor excludes BTIC by itself. The unconditional day comes from the Globex notice. SER-8788 does supply the rationale that explains the whole question: "The halt was initially implemented to account for transactions conducted via open outcry in the trading pits and is therefore no longer necessary." A Globex-only trade type launched in 2015 never had a pit, and never had the halt.
So "all BTIC and TACO products will not be impacted" must be read as "BTIC never had it", not "BTIC kept it". The 2021-06-28 revision belongs to `globex_equity_index`, which already holds it, and MUST NOT be copied onto the BTIC key. Before 2021 the BTIC key's grid is the same 17:00->15:00 CT wrap it has today.
